versions.changelog:
- Initial release.
- Provides step-by-step PowerShell procedures to permanently block WPS Office from hijacking image file associations.
- Detects and disables all WPS-related scheduled tasks.
- Completely removes WPS.PIC.* registry entries from both HKCU and HKLM.
- Automatically searches for and deletes WPS image viewing module files (photo.dll, photolaunch.exe), including renaming executables.
- Instructs the user on how to manually restore desired image viewers as default apps.
